label: PLOS-090
title: Step Quality Firewall contract

blockingCodes.generic_step: Candidate text matches a blocked generic Step phrase.
blockingCodes.generic_pattern: Candidate uses a vague verb with a generic object or pronoun.
blockingCodes.generic_progress_language: Candidate uses progress or improvement language without a concrete artifact, source, proof, or action object.
blockingCodes.generic_repair_required: Generic Step rejection must link to Step Graph Compiler repair and safe fallback.
blockingCodes.missing_specific_action: Candidate has no concrete action verb.
blockingCodes.missing_clear_object: Candidate has no concrete object or target.
blockingCodes.invalid_duration: Candidate duration is missing or outside the allowed range.
blockingCodes.beginner_expert_mismatch: Candidate expects expert skill from a beginner without scaffold.
blockingCodes.expert_after_proof_mismatch: Candidate gives starter-only work to an expert after proof without a recovery reason.
blockingCodes.context_mismatch: Time, energy, resource, location, deadline, or dependency fit is not explicit and fit.
blockingCodes.context_time_mismatch: Candidate does not fit available time.
blockingCodes.context_energy_mismatch: Candidate does not fit available energy.
blockingCodes.context_location_mismatch: Candidate does not fit current or bounded location constraints.
blockingCodes.context_dependency_mismatch: Candidate depends on blocked or unavailable prerequisite work.
blockingCodes.context_repair_required: Context-mismatched Step must link to Step Graph Compiler repair and safe fallback.
blockingCodes.source_not_eligible: Source authority state, freshness, review, risk, or runtime eligibility is not acceptable.
blockingCodes.source_state_blocked: Candidate source state is blocked, stale, revoked, contradicted, unknown, source-needed, or review-required.
blockingCodes.source_trace_missing: Candidate lacks a source trace identifier or source hash.
blockingCodes.source_freshness_invalid: Candidate source freshness is expired, revoked, unknown, stale, or not bounded for starter/local proof.
blockingCodes.source_review_invalid: Candidate source review state is blocked, review-required, or not approved/bounded.
blockingCodes.source_risk_blocked: Candidate source risk class is high, unbounded, jurisdiction-needed, or blocked.
blockingCodes.source_runtime_ineligible: Candidate source is not eligible for runtime use.
blockingCodes.hardcoded_step_output: Candidate appears to be a finished hardcoded Step output rather than a source-bound candidate.
blockingCodes.missing_proof_expectation: Candidate has no proof primitive or receipt requirement.
blockingCodes.proof_receipt_missing: Candidate has no required receipt or accepted receipt kind.
blockingCodes.proof_trace_missing: Candidate has no proof trace identifier.
blockingCodes.source_proof_repair_required: Source/proof failure must link to Step Graph Compiler repair and safe fallback.
blockingCodes.unsafe_or_shaming_tone: Candidate uses unsafe, coercive, or shame language.
blockingCodes.missing_accessibility_semantics: Candidate lacks VoiceOver and non-visual semantics.
blockingCodes.missing_elasticity_coverage: Candidate lacks minimum required Step elasticity coverage.
blockingCodes.missing_repair_path: Rejected or degraded candidate has no compiler repair path or safe fallback.

noClaimBoundary: No production Step Quality Firewall wiring
No R2 write or Source Atlas publication
No release, TestFlight, App Store, privacy, or legal readiness
